description: Check an e-book before and after export_epub. Read-only. Without path it checks the document in InDesign for the given layout (reflowable, default, or fixed_layout): document_language (an EPUB needs dc:language – error when the text defaults have no language), toc_style (error when the named toc_style does not exist; warning when no TOC style is set for the EPUB), metadata (warning without title or creator in the EPUB settings), and for reflowable unanchored_objects (graphics and groups on pages that are not anchored in the text flow – their place in the EPUB follows the export order; anchor_frame_in_text), parent_page_objects (content on parent pages, left out of a reflowable EPUB – fine for running heads and page numbers) and paragraph_styles (stories with basic paragraph styles), image_resolution against min_ppi (from the call or the server configuration epub.min_ppi; skipped without a limit) and fonts (not installed – an error for fixed layout, which needs embedded fonts). With path it checks the finished .epub file without InDesign: zip_structure (mimetype first and uncompressed), container (META-INF/container.xml and the package document), opf_metadata (version, dc:title, dc:language, dc:identifier matching unique-identifier; warning without dc:creator), manifest_files (every manifest file present, spine entries in the manifest), navigation (EPUB 3 nav with a toc, EPUB 2 NCX), references (src and href in the content files point to files in the archive) and cover (warning without a cover image). Returns passed (no error), checked document | file, checks_run[], errors, findings[] {check, severity error | warning, page_id, page_name, object_id or file, hint}, findings_total and findings_truncated (max_findings, default 200); with path also epub_version, layout, title, language, creators[], identifiers[], file_count, nav_document, nav_entries, ncx, cover_image, fonts[] and fonts_obfuscated. It does not replace EPUBCheck or the e-book shop's own preview tool.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

layout.description: Document check: the planned layout. Default reflowable.

min_ppi.description: Document check: lowest effective image resolution. Default: the configured epub.min_ppi, otherwise not checked.

path.description: An exported .epub file to check without InDesign. Without it the document is checked.

toc_style.description: Document check: the TOC style planned for export_epub.

name: check_epub
title: Check a book for EPUB
